title: 255_413270_UFO's_and_Defense_What_Should_we_Prepare_For
doc_notes: This document is a declassified French COMETA report on UFOs and defense, detailing various international and French sightings and the organization of UFO research. / This document is a report by the French association COMETA regarding UFOs and defense, including appendices on historical cases, disinformation, and scientific implications, followed by press clippings discussing the report.

incidents.summary: Mirage IV pilot and navigator observed a very bright glow on a collision course, which maneuvered to follow them at high speed.
incidents.quote: feeling like he was being "watched" according to his own words

incidents.summary: Student pilot in a T-33 training aircraft encountered a phosphorescent green sphere that passed over his wing.
incidents.quote: The aircraft was completely enveloped in a very bright and phosphorescent green light.

incidents.summary: Air France flight crew observed a brown bell-shaped object that transformed into a lens shape before disappearing.
incidents.quote: what they were seeing did not resemble anything that they knew of.

incidents.summary: Multiple radar and visual sightings of unidentified objects moving at high speeds and performing abrupt maneuvers.
incidents.quote: my machine guns are locked onto him.

incidents.summary: RB-47 bomber crew detected an unidentified object via radar and visual observation, with associated microwave emissions.
incidents.quote: The object changed direction several times, describing line segments

incidents.summary: F-4 Phantom interceptors experienced instrument and communication failure when approaching a luminous object.
incidents.quote: An outstanding report. This case is a classic

incidents.summary: Multiple visual sightings of disk-shaped objects performing S-turns and hovering.
incidents.quote: The objects flew at altitudes ranging from 100 to 7000 m.

incidents.summary: Commercial flight crew and ground witnesses observed a luminous object performing maneuvers near an airport.
incidents.quote: the object, which had become luminous, moved behind the airplane

incidents.summary: Large green object observed by hundreds of witnesses, causing animal panic and power outages.
incidents.quote: a sort of metal rugby ball preceded by a clearly detached green lens

incidents.summary: Pilot and wife observed a metallic object hovering near their home before it departed at high speed.
incidents.quote: having the shape of two superposed saucers with very distinct contours

incidents.summary: Military personnel observed disk-shaped objects hovering and performing maneuvers near a missile base.
incidents.quote: The saucer sometimes moved abruptly, but soundlessly

incidents.summary: Witness observed a landed object and two small beings, resulting in temporary paralysis.
incidents.quote: I was totally immobilized in place, numbed and paralyzed

incidents.summary: Two children observed four small beings and a sphere, accompanied by a hissing sound and sulfur odor.
incidents.quote: The sphere took off with a hissing sound, then rose into the sky

incidents.summary: Witness observed a silent metal object land and take off, leaving physical traces on the ground.
incidents.quote: The object, which was ovoid in shape, did not exhibit any apparent projections

incidents.summary: Witness observed an ovoid craft hovering in his garden for 20 minutes.
incidents.quote: ovoid in shape, approximately 1 m in diameter, 80 cm thick

incidents.summary: Three bright disks performed extraordinary aerial maneuvers over an Army missile base near Astrakhan, moving from hovering to high speed silently.
incidents.quote: extraordinary aerial maneuvers of three bright disks

incidents.summary: A silent discoid object was observed moving from hovering to speeds two or three times faster than a modern fighter jet.
incidents.quote: silent discoid object went from hovering to a speed two or three times faster

incidents.summary: A luminescent object hovered above the runway of Barnaul airport, causing a cargo plane crew to refuse takeoff and another to divert.
incidents.quote: luminescent unidentified flying object hovered above its runway
